note: Runs in a project whose .agents/project.json is profiles/example.json (Jira project SHOP, repos shop-api, shop-gateway and shop-web). The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so every prompt invokes it explicitly.

evals.name: start-gates
evals.expected_output: Reads the profile, then the ticket, its comments and siblings; answers Situate in the chat (repos table, what the code contradicts in the ticket, siblings); asks to confirm the scope before assigning and moving to the start status; edits no repo file
assertions: Reads .agents/project.json before the first phase
The repos table gives each repo's role, next to what the ticket changes there and where in the code
Asks for confirmation before any tracker assign or transition
Invokes explain before any Edit or Write on a repo file
Creates or plans the notes file with a Phase line and a Scope section

evals.name: resume-reality-wins
evals.prompt: /delivery on reprend SHOP-431 (the notes say Phase: pair implementation, but gh shows two open PRs)
evals.expected_output: Reads the notes and the plan, checks gh, the tracker status and each worktree, notices PRs exist, corrects the phase to Review and PR or later, says the next phase in one line
assertions: Runs gh pr list with the ticket key
Asks the tracker for the status field only
Corrects the notes' phase from the real state
States the next phase in one line

evals.name: no-send-without-go
evals.prompt: (in phase 6, Review and PR) les PRs sont prêtes
evals.expected_output: Shows one PR package (remaining questions, review findings, PR titles and bodies, reviewers, announcement draft with merge order) and asks once; on the go, opens the PRs and leaves the announcement as a draft, never sent
assertions: Asks once for the whole package before gh pr create
Never sends the announcement: leaves a draft
Includes the merge order in the announcement

evals.name: split-gates-tracker
evals.prompt: (SHOP-157 after Decide: one prefactor plus three slices across shop-api, shop-gateway and shop-web) on découpe
evals.expected_output: Proposes vertical sub-tasks with their blockers, the prefactor first, iterates on granularity, and asks before creating any sub-task in the tracker
assertions: Each proposed slice names the repos it touches and what it delivers
Each slice lists its blockers, the prefactor first
No tracker create before an explicit go

evals.name: address-review-gates-replies
evals.prompt: (in phase 6, Review and PR, address review) Jo demande de renommer une fonction sur shop-api#190
evals.expected_output: Answers each thread through pr (Answering review), runs phase 6's checks on the round's fixes, and shows replies and the push before posting
assertions: Reads the PR's review threads
Runs the review checks on the fix before pushing
No reply posted and no push before an explicit go

evals.name: close-cleans-and-files-leftovers
evals.prompt: (SHOP-157 in its done status, the notes list a local branch image and a Left aside section) on ferme le ticket
evals.expected_output: Lists the local leftovers and the Left aside follow-ups at one gate, acts only on a yes, then trims the notes file
assertions: Lists the local branch image and the compose override to restore
No tracker write and no deletion before an explicit go
Trims the notes to PRs, where they run and follow-ups

evals.name: overview-before-code
evals.prompt: (SHOP-708 after Decide, decisions comment posted) go, on code
evals.expected_output: Gives the work overview first (steps grouped by PR and repo, the decision in each, what is still to verify, merge order), writes PLAN-SHOP-708.md in the user's plans folder outside the repos and opens it, and waits for the go before any code
assertions: Hands the overview to the pair skill
Writes no repo code before the overview gate
Groups the steps by PR and repo with the decision each one holds
Marks the steps that stop (decision or user-written piece)
Writes PLAN-SHOP-708.md in the user's plans folder, outside every repo
Waits for the user's go

evals.name: pair-step-and-markers
evals.prompt: (phase 5, stop step 2 written with a GATE marker on the fee floor, left uncommitted) ok
evals.expected_output: Deletes the GATE marker itself, runs the tests, commits the step, ticks it in the plan, then chains through the plumbing steps up to the next stop, where it opens the first marker, explains in 2 to 4 points what it did and why, and ends with a stop block of three lines at most
assertions: Follows the pair skill's Steps
Deletes the marker itself on « ok »
Never commits a file holding a GATE or TODO pair marker
Commits plumbing steps without stopping
Explains the step first in 2 to 4 points, each with what was done, where (repo, layer, file:line) and why (decision, AC or fact)
Ends with a stop block of at most three lines: step n/N and tests, each marker's file:line and decision, the expected answer

evals.name: no-profile
evals.expected_output: Finds no .agents/project.json; offers project-setup, or discovers the tracker from the link, the default branch from origin/HEAD and the editor from the PATH, asks once for the rest and offers to save the profile; never assumes Jira, a master branch or VS Code
assertions: Looks for .agents/project.json before the first phase
Offers project-setup or asks for the missing fields in one message
Reads the issue with gh issue view
Never assumes Jira, a master branch or a specific editor
